motion.title: Art in Motion — Museum at Airport
motion.desc:
A series of four animations making use of collection images from Hong Kong Heritage Museum and Hong Kong Museum of Art was on display at a massive screen at the Hong Kong International Airport.
The video series was created by illustrator Thomas Siu and animator Henry Chiu. Originated from "Art Seen • Art Screen" project shown at Oi! Deck, images from museum collections were adapted, with the characters and natural environments animated and edited into four individual visual journeys. Vigorous Life, Vivid Expressions gazes at the dance of flowers, birds and insects of Chao Shao-an; Transcending Nature dives through the inking mists of Chan Chik, Shitao, and Cheng Tinglu; Sights of Stories strolls along various corners of Hong Kong with Kong Kai-ming and Au Yeung Nai-chim; A Pleasure in Art: Chinese Painting and Calligraphy Appreciation glimpses into the world of falling leaves and gurgling streams of Gong Xian, Mei Qing and Gao Jian of the Chih Lo Lou Collection.
The project was part of the HKIA Arts and Culture Festival 2023, organised by Hong Kong International Airport with an aim to showcase the rich culture heritage and creativity of Hong Kong to travellers from all over the world.

Client: Art Promotion Office
Director: Thomas Siu
Animation: Easemotion

motion.title: Lights Up｜Architectural Projection Mapping in Historical Buildings
motion.desc: Lights Up is an architectural projection mapping project and the first exposition of Lights Up was held at The Mills, the revitalized creative and cultural landmark that was once a textile mill. Invited by Daaimung Lab, we are delighted to take part in episode 2 and part of episode 4 of the project. Combining the visual texture of light and shade with the highlighted historical stories of Nam Fung Factory in 70s and 80s, we designed sets of 2D & 3D animation and architectural projection mapping to present the Mill in past, present and the future.
